scope: Mechanical test/API mapping for a bounded graft evidence producer-to-consumer fixture. No new harness, model measurement or qualification. CLI arrays below are appended to [node, ABS_PINNED_PLUGIN_BIN]; placeholders are host-bound isolated paths.
minimal_source_spec:
# Fixture

## DONE

- [ ] [ac-1] the supplied arithmetic command MUST pass
- [ ] [ac-2] needs-human: Prices match the published pricing page

sequence.required_seed: Owned no-remote temporary git repo, local operator fixture identity, main baseline commit and feature branch. Empty/safe package.json test script true. Write source spec outside worktree, docs/ directory and explicit tracking:none fixture config using the tested layout. RUN_DIR must be ROOT/.faff/runs/RUN_NAME for subsequent evidence writers.
sequence.expect: Capture path, commit, source/committed hashes from token committed or already-committed. Keep spec-commit.json in RUN_DIR/FAFF-9. Do not derive its date-stamped path yourself.
exit0, token verified and matching path; working-tree or HEAD rewrite exits1 mismatch. Missing/ambiguous committed spec exits2. Bind source input bytes and actual committed builder bytes.

Use actual returned qualified ac_ids. Explicit needs-human marker yields human_only:true, verification_tier delegated and verifier ac-checklist for ac-2. Do not infer human-only from subjectivity or mark it passed.

sequence.step: execute automatic check and write checklist
sequence.precondition: Actually execute the supplied arithmetic command and retain argv/stdout/stderr/exit before asserting passed:true. Example verified string must describe that actual capture.

criteria.ac: the supplied arithmetic command MUST pass
Prices match the published pricing page
criteria.verified: Needs human verification: published prices have not been inspected

sequence.expect: exit0, stdout written absolute path; writer stamps schema_version1 and current faff_version. Persisted all_verified remains false. Writer requires string ac_id on every row, rejects inconsistent aggregate/passed flags and invalid method shapes.
Real writer emits human-only-acs.json plus hash-bound human-only-acs-stamp event. Requires existing real genesis chain. Do not hand-synthesise stamp for a producer proof.

exit0; Markdown starts ## Acceptance Criteria, checked automatic row and unchecked human row with identical ids; Method: command locator and Method: human. This proves anchor-to-render consistency, not PR publication.

One JSON line {issue,ac_checklist:{present,sha256},review_verdict:{present,sha256},human_only_acs:{present,sha256}}. Digests cover exact raw bytes including final newline. Return is an identity statement, not schema/fidelity proof. Passing review evidence must already exist as a declared controlled dependency.

sequence.stdin: Exact captured evidence return stdout, not rebuilt digests
sequence.expect: exit0 verdict agree, all three files match; evidence_persisted contains issue/ac_sha256/review_verdict_sha256/human_only_acs_sha256. Command reports this entry but does not itself save it in ledger.

sequence.step: persist returned witness then verify against ledger
sequence.host_operation: Use existing production heartbeat.mutateLedgerUnderLock(RUN_DIR, fresh => ({...fresh,evidence_persisted:[verified.evidence_persisted]})) for this one-issue fixture; preserve any other fields. Existing entries require replace-by-issue rather than truncation in a multi-issue fixture. Real serialiser stamps/validates ledger and folds ledger-write.
sequence.expect: exit0 agree with no stdin required; unknown/malformed digest ledger exits2, changed evidence exits1 mismatch. Bind updated ledger bytes and folded event hash.

sequence.step: mint actual anchor and consume with local gate
sequence.between_commands: Commit the complete actual minted anchor on feature. ReadAnchoredHumanOnly obtains its declaration+stamp and anchored L3 level from this exact branch HEAD; AC checklist/review floor are read from live RUN_DIR. Capture both live and committed anchor bytes.
sequence.expect: With controlled passing review/local test dependency, no remote and correct anchor, ac_called_out is [faff-9#ac-2] and the AC blocker is absent. For full merge-ok require all independent floor legs to pass; never waive another blocker to claim full gate success. --check-only performs no branch merge or hosted/tracker write, but runs actual safe fixture local tests.

reuse.recommendation: Prefer mkScopeRun(ROOT,{runName:RUN_NAME,admitted:[FAFF-9]}) to seed a real schema-valid run ledger, real genesis+bound-ledger event chain and controlled conforming review dependency; then overwrite only checklist through real writer. mintScopeAnchor calls production mintIssueAnchor. Alternatively mkChainedRun seeds genesis/build-start but its fixed FAFF-1 issue must not be mistaken for FAFF-9 execution; use mkScopeRun for this case.

These helpers are not exported; do not import the whole test file, which registers/runs tests. Copy only tiny owned-repo setup into the existing harness if needed. Do not reuse commitAnchor synthetic stamp for end-to-end producer proof; use real human writer+events anchor and commit those outputs.
Use setup shape and real spec commit/verify API. No spec-verify.test.mjs exists; spec-commit.test.mjs contains real verify coverage. Record actual date-stamped path returned by spec commit.

Additional narrow handler assertion can independently call readAcFloor(RUN_DIR,FAFF-9,{unattended:true,ids:[faff-9#ac-2]}) -> {complete:true,called_out:[faff-9#ac-2]}. Keep exact all_verified:false persisted checklist; the skip is conditional merge eligibility, not human verification.

required_negatives: Change one evidence byte after returned digest: verify-return and against-ledger must exit1 mismatch.
Unattended false, missing/edited human declaration, missing/mismatched stamp, or anchored level mismatch: no human skip and AC blocker remains.
Human row missing ac_id, mixed/nonhuman/empty verifications, additional unlisted pending AC, or no passed automatic AC: readAcFloor remains blocked.
Rewrite committed spec or worktree spec: spec verify rejects; classifier ids must continue to match written and rendered rows.
Do not replace full schema-valid ledger with the minimal {evidence_persisted:[entry]} used by isolated return unit test; it would undermine the actual anchor/gate setup.
boundaries: A real successful review or hosted PR is not generated by this fixture. Passing review is a supplied controlled dependency; manual recovery writer --terminal-only must not be labelled a real review workflow.
L3 unattended fixture is sufficient for human-only skip. L4 adds independent holdout/progress/Commissaire gates; an AC-blocker-absent result alone does not mean L4 merge-ok.
Use no-remote owned temporary repositories and --check-only for local gate. Never run local --execute against the shared worktree.

Freeze imported helper and full production dependency closure, including current-root helper imports. If invoking a pinned runtime, assert helper-loaded modules match the registered runtime rather than silently mixing versions.

These examples were checked against source/tests only, not executed as a combined scenario. Required next evidence is one deterministic actual CLI preflight in the existing infrastructure with exact inputs/results/files.
